definitions.short: Baal-Chanan , the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite
definitions.full: H1177. Baal Chanan חָנָן בַּ֫עַל proper name, masculine ( Baal is gracious , compare Phoenician חנבעל & (in Assyrian) Baal—anunu ) 1 king of Edom Gen 36:38-39 , 1Chr 1:49-50 ,. 2 a Gederite 1Chr 27:28 .
